title: armeria juniperifolia var. isernii
intro: Armeria juniperifolia var. isernii, commonly known as Mountain Thyme, is a flowering plant species in the primrose family, Primulaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to boost the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Thyme include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and colds, as well as its antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Thyme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
